blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Steam engine (bhaap ka engine) ek thermodynamical system hai.

Heat engine kuch thermal energy (garmi ki energy) ko mechanical work mein badalta hai. Aam taur par yeh heat fuel (eendhan) jalne se aati hai. Sab se pehla heat engine steam engine tha. Yeh is baat se bana ke jab dhakkan wale bartan mein pani ubala jaye to andar ki bhaap dhakkan ko upar dhakelti hai, yani bhaap work kar sakti hai. Isi observation (ghaur se dekhna) se steam engine banaya gaya.

Heat engine ka principle (qaida) yeh hai ke heat energy ek cyclic process (baar baar dohraya jane wala chakkar) ke zariye mechanical work mein badalti hai. Heat engine mein heat energy baar baar high temperature reservoir (garam hissa jahan se heat aati hai) se low temperature reservoir (thanda hissa jahan heat jati hai) ki taraf jati hai, aur koshish yeh hoti hai ke zyada se zyada heat work ban jaye. Yeh process thermodynamics ke principles ke mutabiq chalta hai aur har us jagah kaam aata hai jahan heat se mechanical energy chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Heat engine ko cycle mein kyun chalna parta hai, aur jo heat work nahi banti woh kahan jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Cycle hi engine ko lagatar work karne deta hai: har chakkar ke baad working substance apni shuru wali halat mein wapas aa jata hai, is liye ek cycle mein us ki internal energy ki change (badlao) zero hoti hai. Jo heat work mein nahi badalti woh low temperature reservoir, yani surroundings (aas paas ki cheezein), ko de di jati hai.

items: Heat engine garam reservoir se thande reservoir ki taraf heat ke cyclic flow (behna) se thermal energy (aam taur par jalte fuel se) ko mechanical work mein badalta hai; sab se pehla heat engine steam engine tha.
